subject: Request: conditional top-up of accelerator credits for demo day
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@pocketlabs.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick ask before demo day — supplemental credits?

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks again for the warm onboarding — PocketLabs has been ramping up experiments this month and the team is excited for the demo day on Dec 8. We’re tracking through our consumption and it looks like we’ll exceed the free cohort allowance by ~40% if we keep current pacing.

Two quick questions:
- Is there a short-term option to add a conditional top-up of credits that only triggers if we hit the demo-day milestone?
- If so, can that be time-boxed and tied to specific usage caps? We’d prefer not to commit to a long-term reserved seat yet.

Happy to jump on a short call if that’s easier. Attaching a one-page milestone plan to show what the extra consumption will buy us.

Best,
Claire Nguyen
Founder, PocketLabs
[attachment: PocketLabs_MilestonePlan.pdf (PDF, 1 page)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@pocketlabs.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask before demo day — supplemental credits?

Claire — thanks for the note and the plan, looks helpful.

Short answer: we can do a conditional top-up for accelerator cohorts; we usually structure it as a time-boxed top-up credit pool tied to milestone acceptance. A few clarifying points before I put a formal proposal together:

- How large is the 40% in absolute token/compute terms (rough estimate is fine)?
- Would PocketLabs accept a top-up that is refund-eligible if the milestone isn’t reached (reduced credit applied back to your account)?
- Any procurement/regulatory requirements we should know about (POs, legal addendums)?

If OK I’ll loop in Mina (payments & promo approvals) and draft an addendum with: top-up size, timebox (to Dec 20), milestone acceptance criteria, and a limited refund/window clause. If that sounds like the right approach I’ll aim to get something to you tomorrow.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior SMB GTM, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Claire Nguyen <claire@pocketlabs.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27T20:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask before demo day — supplemental credits?

Thanks Ben — quick answers below inline:

> How large is the 40% in absolute token/compute terms (rough estimate is fine)?
It’s about 1200 compute-hours across our staging/demo pipelines. If you prefer token units, that maps to roughly 2.1M tokens.

> Would PocketLabs accept a top-up that is refund-eligible if the milestone isn’t reached?
Yes — we’re open to a refund window, though we’d prefer it be pro-rated (e.g., refund any unused credits after the timebox) rather than an all-or-nothing pass/fail.

> Any procurement/regulatory requirements?
We’re small — legal might ask for a short addendum and a PO. It shouldn’t be heavy.

Call would be fine if you need to iron details tomorrow morning (PST).

See you,
Claire

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@pocketlabs.io>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-28T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: conditional top-up — draft addendum attached

Claire / team — attaching a short draft addendum that captures the ask and a conservative top-up number. Key points:

- Top-up size: equivalent of 2.5M tokens (covers the 40% buffer)
- Timebox: Dec 1–20, 2026
- Refund clause: pro-rated refund of unused credits after Dec 20, capped at 50% refund if milestone not met (we can be flexible here)
- Acceptance: PocketLabs confirms milestone completion in writing to redwood-sales@redwood.ai; legal can execute a one-page addendum.

Attachments: RL-accelerator-credit-addendum.docx (draft) — this is a lightweight commercial addendum, not a full MSA.

Next steps I propose:
1) Claire — confirm the top-up size and the pro-rate refund approach is acceptable.
2) Mina — can you review the draft and confirm promo approval for a one-off addendum (I put a conservative credit amount to minimize upside risk).

If we get approvals today we can route to PocketLabs legal and DocuSign and have the credits available within 24–48 hours.

—Ben
